{{Quote|But my father didn't fight in the Clone Wars. He was no knight-&mdash;just a navigator on a space freighter.|[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]|<ref name="Star Wars Episode IV: A New Hope (novel)">[[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|''Star Wars Episode IV: A New Hope'']]</ref>}}
A '''navigator''', also known as an '''astrogator''' or '''navigation officer''', was a person who navigated [[Starship/Legends|starships]].

Aboard starships, the navigator was responsible for plotting a vessel's course through [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] with the aid of a [[Navigation computer/Legends|navigation computer]]. Calculating routes took a varied amount of [[Time/Legends|time]] depending on the difficulty of the hyperspace jump; well-traveled routes and pre-calculated coordinates took [[Standard minute/Legends|minutes]], while calculating the coordinates from scratch could take several [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]]. More difficult journies, such as attempting to calculate a jump from a position where the navigator had to take readings to verify the ship's position, could take up to a [[Standard day/Legends|day]].<ref name="RPG1" />

[[Tessa Manchisco]] was a navigator in the [[Virgillian Free Alignment Starfleet]]. [[Monnda Tebbo]] was a [[Navigator/Legends|navigation officer]] in both the Virgillian Free Alignment Starfleet and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], and served as Chief Navigator aboard the ''[[Flurry]]'' during the [[Invasion of Bakura]].<ref name="Bakura Sourcebook">''[[The Truce at Bakura Sourcebook]]''</ref> [[Kane Griggs]] served as a navigator aboard the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] ''[[Emancipator]]'' during the [[Battle of Calamari]].
